rules: A visible page or button is not complete unless it invokes an authoritative API/runtime and renders the returned outcome.
Read-only observation must never be described as execution or authorization.
No mock data may be presented as production state.
Existing engines, identity, evidence, release gates, and platform boundaries remain authoritative.
Unknown capabilities remain UNKNOWN until verified.

capabilities.detail: Reads live health, jobs, agents, and job evidence; cloud worker is explicitly shown as not deployed.
capabilities.acceptance: Retain live API and no-demo-data behavior; add interaction tests.

capabilities.detail: Calls /v1/ai/generate and persists local conversation history in browser localStorage; wide layout is persisted. Cross-device durable sync and user-facing provider/model/agent/plugin selection are not complete.
capabilities.acceptance: Verify local history restore/clear and error recovery; add supported provider/model routing only when the backend exposes the active route and validated provider/model contract; do not claim browser storage is durable cloud history.

capabilities.detail: Reads ProjectRegistry and Workspace Index; PR #92 adds workspace selection and live knowledge search through /v2/workspaces/{id}/knowledge. Project CRUD and file upload/edit/delete remain unavailable because no authoritative API is exposed here.
capabilities.acceptance: Verify workspace selection/search and provenance rendering; add project/file mutations only after authoritative APIs and ownership rules are confirmed.

capabilities.detail: Reads owner-scoped jobs and orchestration runs; PR #92 adds job evidence and workflow detail/timeline drill-down. Search, filters, and pagination remain outstanding.
capabilities.acceptance: Verify evidence/timeline drill-down against live API responses; add query/filter/pagination using supported API parameters.

capabilities.detail: Web page now reads authenticated account, login provider catalog, active AI provider, and secret-safe provider connection status; settings mutations are not exposed.
capabilities.acceptance: Expose only configuration changes backed by server-side APIs, approval/audit, and secret-safe validation.

capabilities.detail: OWNER-only management inventory and audit are live; UI also creates organization/project/application/API metadata and exposes API publish/disable lifecycle actions through the Management API. User/role/policy/credential lifecycle remains unavailable.
capabilities.acceptance: Keep server-side OWNER/RBAC, relationship validation, and audit atomicity; expose additional user/role/policy/credential actions only after their canonical lifecycle and recovery APIs exist.

capabilities.detail: Reads ProjectRegistry metadata and renders project details; no project mutation/open-file operations in this page.
capabilities.acceptance: Add supported project actions only after confirming authoritative API contracts.

capabilities.detail: Workflow Experience reads runs/timelines and links to Agent Center; Agent Center exposes create, execute, approval/confirm, retry, cancel, and timeline controls through the existing Owner-authorized API. The workflow page itself remains observational.
capabilities.acceptance: Verify navigation and all Agent Center lifecycle actions with Flutter widget/API integration tests; keep Owner authorization and explicit confirmation enforced server-side.

capabilities.detail: Local conversation persistence and optional cloud conversation sync exist; provider/model/agent/plugin capability coverage requires separate verification.
capabilities.acceptance: Verify real send path, provider/model routing, cross-device sync behavior, and failure recovery.

capabilities.detail: Runtime observations are API-backed; command actions include local navigation and local simulation toggles, while audit snapshots are locally assembled. The pure control kernel delegates I/O to adapters.
capabilities.acceptance: Bind each command to an existing authoritative executor or label it prepare/inspect only; persist audit evidence through canonical evidence services.

capabilities.detail: Server-derived owner identity and health/projects/workflows/agents/providers observations are displayed; page is intentionally read-only.
capabilities.acceptance: Preserve authority boundary; only add actions backed by owner-authorized server workflows.

capabilities.detail: A general user-facing plugin marketplace/install/permission/audit lifecycle is still missing. Existing Web Plugin Center does provide first-party Google Workspace OAuth connect/disconnect/service selection and secret-safe AI provider connection status; this is not a third-party marketplace.
capabilities.acceptance: If a general marketplace is required, implement a server-owned manifest/connection/secret/permission/audit lifecycle; do not treat first-party connectors or the V3 runtime registry as marketplace installation.

capabilities.detail: OWNER-authenticated metadata CRUD/lifecycle exists with JSON persistence and separate API-key lifecycle; usage/cost are empty runtime-ledger projections.
capabilities.acceptance: Verify production persistence, credential secrecy, audit atomicity, approval and runtime-ledger integration before exposing mutations.

capabilities.detail: Dedicated Control Center workflow watches Web/API and selected Flutter paths and runs Web syntax/source-contract tests across Ubuntu/Windows/macOS. It does not yet run Flutter analyze/widget tests in this gate.
capabilities.acceptance: Add Flutter analyze and focused widget/API integration tests to the dedicated gate, while retaining exact-SHA Web/API checks.

capabilities.detail: Adds a Web Agent Center for live Agent/readiness/run views, plan creation, timeline inspection, and OWNER-gated approve/execute/retry/cancel actions with explicit browser confirmation. Completion remains PARTIAL until authenticated OWNER and non-OWNER integration paths are verified end-to-end.
capabilities.acceptance: Verify create/approve/execute/retry/cancel/timeline end-to-end with an authenticated OWNER and a non-OWNER; server-side authorization must remain authoritative and execution must never happen automatically.

capabilities.detail: Replaces static directory cards with live API-backed views for graph, evidence, jobs, workspaces, readiness, providers, runtime, orchestration, and audit surfaces. Modules without a verified API/executor explicitly show NOT CONNECTED; hardware/EFI/research-gap/hypothesis executors remain unavailable.
capabilities.acceptance: Verify every mapped endpoint and role boundary; keep unsupported modules explicitly unavailable until a canonical API/runtime executor and tests exist.
